claude.reason: The chart shows REGN is on its fourth breakout attempt from a 60-session move that has already stalled below the August high near 860 — the shaded base sits visibly below prior peaks with clear overhead supply from that August cluster of high-volume red bars. RE fails outright (burst bar is only 76% of the prior 5-bar range), and Y fails hard (breakout_4 of this move), meaning the trend is aged and the burst bar itself is narrow and unimpressive relative to recent action. The base is geometrically acceptable but the context — a declining 20-SMA, price below the August highs, and a fourth push — makes this a late, supply-laden entry.
claude.key_risk: Four prior breakouts into the same overhead zone near 850 with heavy red volume above current price; a failed fourth attempt could accelerate the pullback already visible in the base.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the burst-day close of 789.45 or if the first 30 minutes show no buying interest above 790.

row.summary: REGN: +1.9% on 1.8× volume out of a base 10.4% deep. C 8.5, 5 of 6 criteria.
